"""Recreates isolated production empty-reply microbenchmark source variants."""

import argparse
import io
import subprocess
import tarfile
from pathlib import Path


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--git", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-revision", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--original-revision", default="86e598c4ec")
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    def git(*arguments):
        return subprocess.check_output([str(args.git), *arguments], cwd=args.repo)

    module = "crates/crucible-qemu-plugin/src/runtime/live_whitebox/selectable.rs"
    tests = module.removesuffix(".rs") + "/tests.rs"
    original = git("show", args.original_revision + ":" + module).decode()
    start = original.index("        let Some(entry) = self.reply_input.peek()? else {")
    end = original.index("\n    /// Dispatches one selectable message", start)
    original_body = original[start:end]
    benchmark = Path(__file__).with_name("benchmark-tests.rs").read_text()
    archive = git("archive", args.source_revision, "crates")

    for label in ("baseline", "optimized"):
        destination = args.output / (label + "-source")
        destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as source:
            source.extractall(destination, filter="data")
        test_path = destination / tests
        test_path.write_text(test_path.read_text() + benchmark)

        if label == "baseline":
            path = destination / module
            source = path.read_text()
            start = source.index("        if !self.reply_input.has_reply()? {")
            end = source.index("\n    // Keep entry-sized return values", start)
            path.write_text(source[:start] + original_body + source[end:])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
